title: palicourea longicuspis
intro: Palicourea longicuspis, commonly known as "Culebra", is a plant species within the family Rubiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Amazon region, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Palicourea longicuspis include its antimalarial, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, antispasmodic, and antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents of Palicourea longicuspis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
